summary: This step builds the Track 2 answer from iteration 4 alone. Four sources that share no data each proposed approved drugs by a rule fixed before any join: the PrimeKG walk (50 drugs), the child's phenotype twin among mouse models (2), a screen-wide PRISM sweep (8) and LINCS signature reversal (3), 62 drugs in all. The sweep found no Launched drug selective for rhabdomyosarcoma or aneuploid lines after correction (best q 0.122 and 0.287), and LINCS reversal is uninterpretable because its positive control failed. The four lists share one drug, dasatinib (twin and PRISM), which is what a permutation null expects by chance (p 0.263). Dasatinib passes the three checks: mechanism direction, the child's own safety from his genome and his clinical terms, and a contrary screen result. Vincristine is the one drug both safety sources flag.
why: Step 9's E4 and E5+E6 tested drugs drawn from iteration 2's shortlist. A submission built from iteration 4 only cannot borrow that list, so iteration 4 must generate its own candidates and re-run its checks on them.
verdict: Three claims settled. H093 refuted (0.10): no eligible Launched drug reaches q < 0.10 in either PRISM contrast, while the positive-control sweep recovers the RAF inhibitors. H094 refuted (0.15): one converging drug against a null 95th percentile of 1.0, none without the pre-known dasatinib. H095 supported weakly (0.40): dasatinib passes every check, but its convergence is chance-level and it was known before the join.

inherits.what: Step 7's PrimeKG walk ranking, step 9's phenotype twin interventions (E2), PRISM readers and tests (E4), the per-child safety method (E5+E6) and the LINCS signature reversal (E3). The confirmed BUB1B pair comes from Track 1's oracle reply (entry 083).

hands_to.what: The candidate table and survivors for submissions/track2/iteration-4/.

figures.name: step10-s1-volcano.svg
figures.reads: Cliff's delta against -log10 one-sided p for three families run through one code path: skin/melanoma lines vs the rest over 2,032 launched drugs (the positive control), rhabdomyosarcoma vs the rest over 613, and high vs low aneuploidy over 613. Dabrafenib and vemurafenib sit far above the BH line; in the two real contrasts no drug crosses it.
figures.means: PRISM has no launched drug selective for either of the child's contexts at a corrected level, and the pipeline can find one when one exists. H093 is refuted.
figures.source: tools/render_step10_s1.py over ressources/track2/it4/prism_sweep.tsv and build/it4/track2-s1/; entry 154

figures.name: step10-s1-percentiles.svg
figures.reads: Each of 613 drugs placed by its delta percentile in the rhabdomyosarcoma contrast (x) and the aneuploidy contrast (y); Spearman rho -0.112. The 8 G3-listed drugs lie along the two edges, none in the top-right decile of both.
figures.means: The two contrasts are independent sources that do not pick the same drugs, so a drug good for both would have to be found, not assumed.

figures.name: step10-s1-funnel.svg
figures.reads: 6,790 PRISM compounds, 2,189 marked Launched, 633 eligible copies, 613 eligible drugs, 8 G3-listed, 0 with q < 0.10 in both contrasts; 1,489 newer compounds carry no PRISM phase.
figures.means: Coverage and the approval label, not only biology, bound what the screen can say.

figures.name: step10-s2-upset.svg
figures.reads: An UpSet view of 62 approved drugs across the four generators (walk 50, twin 2, PRISM 8, LINCS 3). One combination holds two generators: twin and PRISM share dasatinib. Every other drug is named by one generator alone.
figures.means: The four independent sources almost never name the same drug.
figures.source: tools/render_step10_s2.py over ressources/track2/it4/candidates.tsv and build/it4/track2-s2/convergence.json; entry 155

figures.name: step10-s2-null.svg
figures.reads: The permutation null (10,000 draws, seed 20260925) of 'drugs named by at least 2 generators' for six tests. Primary: observed 1, null 95th percentile 1.0, p 0.263. Without dasatinib: 0, p 1. Without LINCS: p 0.261. With the twin's narrowest universe: p 0.329.
figures.means: One agreement is what chance gives; H094 is refuted, and no sensitivity changes that.

figures.name: step10-s2-checks.svg
figures.reads: Check matrix for the converging drug and each generator's top 10 (22 of 62 drugs). Dasatinib passes K1, K2 and K3 and is the one survivor. Cautions are mostly drugs with no mechanism annotation. The one K2 fail, vincristine (walk #13), is outside the top 10 and is listed in the entry's table.
figures.means: Dasatinib is iteration 4's only candidate that converges and passes every check: a pre-known lead that survived, not a discovery.
